# NCLEX To-Do List

## 📋 Before You Start Studying

- [ ] Register with your state board of nursing
- [ ] Submit ATT (Authorization to Test) application
- [ ] Schedule your exam date
- [ ] Gather study materials and resources
- [ ] Assess your baseline knowledge (take a practice test)
- [ ] Create a study schedule/calendar

---

## 📚 Study Materials to Get

- [ ] UWorld Q-Bank (highly recommended)
- [ ] Saunders Comprehensive Review book
- [ ] Mark Klimek audio lectures (free)
- [ ] Kaplan or ATI review (if available)
- [ ] NCLEX-style flashcards (Quizlet or physical)
- [ ] NGN (Next Generation NCLEX) practice resources

---

## 🧠 Content Areas to Review

- [ ] Pharmacology (priority medications)
- [ ] Med-Surg fundamentals
- [ ] Maternal/Newborn nursing
- [ ] Pediatric nursing
- [ ] Mental health/Psychiatric nursing
- [ ] Leadership & Management
- [ ] Infection control & Safety
- [ ] Acid-base balance
- [ ] Lab values (memorize critical ones)
- [ ] Prioritization & delegation

---

## ✅ Daily Study Habits

- [ ] Do **75-100 practice questions per day**
- [ ] **Review ALL rationales** (right AND wrong answers)
- [ ] Watch content videos for weak areas
- [ ] Take notes on repeated mistakes
- [ ] Review 10-15 pharmacology drugs daily
- [ ] Use the **NCLEX decision tree** for priority questions

---

## 🎯 Test-Taking Strategies

- [ ] Learn **Maslow's Hierarchy** for prioritization
- [ ] Master **ABC** (Airway, Breathing, Circulation)
- [ ] Practice **SATA** (Select All That Apply) questions
- [ ] Study **NGN question formats**
   - [ ] Bowtie questions
   - [ ] Matrix questions
   - [ ] Extended drag-and-drop
- [ ] Practice eliminating wrong answers
- [ ] Never change answers unless certain

---

## 📅 Week Before the Exam

- [ ] Slow down on new content
- [ ] Review notes and weak areas only
- [ ] Take a full-length practice exam
- [ ] Confirm testing center location
- [ ] Plan your route/parking
- [ ] Prepare your valid ID
- [ ] Get your sleep schedule on track

---

## 🌙 Night Before the Exam

- [ ] Lay out clothes and ID
- [ ] Pack a light snack
- [ ] Avoid studying late
- [ ] Go to bed at a reasonable hour
- [ ] Set multiple alarms

---

## ☀️ Day of the Exam

- [ ] Eat a solid breakfast
- [ ] Arrive **30 minutes early**
- [ ] Bring valid photo ID
- [ ] Take deep breaths and stay calm
- [ ] Trust your preparation
- [ ] Use the **Pearson Vue trick** after (optional)

---

## 💡 Pro Tips

> - Aim for **60%+ on UWorld** as a good benchmark
> - Focus on **why** answers are correct, not memorization
> - The NCLEX tests **critical thinking**, not just facts
> - Take **breaks** to avoid burnout
> - Join an NCLEX study group or Discord community

---

**Good luck! You've got this! 🩺**
